F1: get_item_key` calls `math.floor`/`math.ceil` on a `datetime` value (`order_by="-datetime"`), so any nonempty optimized response raises `TypeError` while its cursors are built.
F2: organization_context.member.has_global_access` runs on every request from a non-superuser, even without `optimized_pagination`, so requests with no member (e.g. org-level API keys) now crash.
F3: The changed `cursors.py` now allows negative offsets, and Django's `queryset[-1:...]` raises `ValueError` instead of `BadPaginationError`, so a crafted cursor returns a 500.
F4: This is a one-time deployment concern, not a code defect: legacy set keys expire within `redis_ttl` (1h), and `ZUNIONSTORE` accepts plain sets as inputs, so any `WRONGTYPE` errors stop on their own.
